title: Clips snap to markers, and a marker drags to a new moment
goal: Markers are where an editor notes a moment to come back to, and in Premiere and Final Cut a clip dragged near one catches on it. In Photonz a clip's edge catches on the playhead and on other clips, but slides straight past a marker, and a marker put down in the wrong place can only be removed and added again because it cannot be dragged. Make markers something you can cut and arrange to.
notes: Manager pass 2026-10-05, objective gap against video-cutting success line 'Drag a clip along a track and onto another track, with snapping to clips, the playhead and markers'. Evidence: PhotonzCore/ClipBarDrag.swift:310-327 clipBarEdges lists the document ends, the playhead and clip edges/joins, no markers. TimelineDock.swift:881-888 marker flags ignore clicks; only Extract's ripple moves a marker (MarkedStretch.swift:123). Only the ruler range snaps to markers (RulerRange.swift:118-124); the playhead snaps to keys only (EditorState+KeyLanes.swift:375-381). TimelineMarker is id + atMS (TimelineMarks.swift:14-23). Naming a marker is NOT in scope (it would add a new field; left as an open thread in the manager report).
acceptance: With snapping on (S), dragging a clip or trimming its edge catches on a marker within the same reach it catches on the playhead, and the line under the drag names it (for example 'caught on a marker at 0:12')
The playhead dragged along the ruler catches on markers too while snapping is on
A marker on the ruler drags left or right to a new moment, snapping to clips and the playhead, in one undo step; a click on it still moves the playhead there
With snapping off, nothing catches on a marker
Unit tests in PhotonzCore cover markers in the snap edges and moving a marker, written first
A walk at Next defaults adds a marker with M, drags a clip to it and photographs the catch, then drags the marker and checks its new time
Works at Next defaults with no switch turned on, and an audit written under queue/audits/ gives the try steps and a real picture
Anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar, and written into this task's log if it does not

log.note: Adversarial review before building: (1) M drops a marker UNDER the playhead, so a press there is ambiguous. Premiere's rule kept: the playhead wins, the marker is dragged once the playhead is elsewhere; a click on a marker puts the playhead exactly on it. (2) In/Out band ends still win over a marker (their grips are what is drawn there). (3) A marker dragged onto another becomes one marker (the model already says two on one frame are one). (4) A dragged marker catches on cuts, clip ends, both document ends and the playhead, never on another marker. (5) Clip moves and trims both read clipBarEdges, so one change covers both; the capsule says 'caught on a marker at 0:12' (26 chars, inside the chrome budget). (6) Over a marker the pointer shows the left-right arrows the band ends use, so it reads as draggable. No mock draws a marker drag; Premiere is the reference.

left rough (none filed; none clears the bar): (a) 'caught on …' is spoken in the bar readout, not drawn, same as every catch today; the green catch line is the on-screen cue. (b) A marker under the playhead is dragged only after the playhead moves off it (Premiere's rule; asked in the audit's evaluate). (c) No time capsule during a marker drag, same as the In/Out band ends. (d) The pointer walk uses window points measured off the probe's pictures (194 pt/s, 0:00 at x 160); a change of dock layout would move them.

Markers are snap edges for clip moves and trims (capsule readout 'caught on a marker at 0:02'), the playhead dragged on the ruler catches on markers, and a marker's flag drags to a new moment catching on cuts and the playhead in one undo step; a click puts the playhead on it. Core: ClipBarDrag.clipBarEdges, TimelineMarks.moveMarker/playheadSnapMoments/markerSnapMoments, RulerRange.grip(.marker)/markerMoved; app: EditorState+RulerRange, TimelineDock ruler. Verified: MarkerSnapTests (written first) + full suite 11367 green; walks clips-snap-to-markers-walk and drag-a-marker-by-hand-walk (real pointer) pass at Next defaults with 8 real captures. Audit queue/audits/2026-10-05-clips-snap-to-markers.json.
